t: Interview with G.J. Vermeij
c: Interview with G.J. Vermeij (1995) reports on a meeting between Michael Costa, Mark Cutkosky and Prof. G.J. Vermeij, a blind field paleontologist at U.C. Davis. The notes cover tactile exploration and perception at different scales of length and time, from textures to 3D geometry. They provide food for thought for the designers of tactile sensors and displays.
